## AC-1

`line_vat` uses floor division (`src/invoice.py:15`), so 20% of 1258, which is 251.6, becomes 251 instead of 252.
That happens on every run; the test is not flaky. I left the test as it is and did not skip it (`AGENTS.md:9-10`).

From my own run (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`: 4 tests, 1 failure), the claims in `.harness/runs/2026-11-18-invoice-vat/S03-claims.md` say:

- AC-1: not met, the rounding test fails with 251 != 252.

So I could not write AC-1 as met. S03 needs the rounding fixed first; I changed no code and no tests.
